app.title: Antigravity Transcript Viewer
app.welcomeDesc: Select a session in the left panel. The log file is read incrementally without locking writes and updates in real time.
app.emptyFeedFilter: No steps match the current filter.

topbar.selectTranscript: Select a transcript on the left
topbar.followTitle: Auto-scroll to bottom as new steps arrive

toolbar.filterAllTitle: Show all log steps: messages, tool_calls, GENERIC tool outputs, and system events
toolbar.filterDialogTitle: Clean conversation only: user prompts, final AI answers, checkpoints, and errors
toolbar.filterErrorsTitle: Steps with errors only (ERROR_MESSAGE, status=ERROR, or non-zero exit codes)
toolbar.cmdErrorsTitle: Show only steps and commands that ended with an error (non-zero exit code or ERROR)
toolbar.searchPlaceholder: Search: words AND, "exact phrase", OR, NOT/!…
toolbar.searchInputTitle: Search in session (Alt+↓ / Alt+↑ for search history)
toolbar.expandAllTitle: Expand all thinking and tool_calls blocks
toolbar.collapseAllTitle: Collapse all thinking and tool_calls blocks
toolbar.tocTitle: Jump to table of contents & cache map at the start of the session
toolbar.cmdMapTitle: Open command & event map with statistics and right-side minimap markers

searchPopover.focusedOnlyDesc: Keep only matching blocks/tools (together with their command outputs) visible. Sibling calls without all search terms collapse behind a reveal button.
searchPopover.wholeTurnDesc: Off (default): all terms must match inside the same block or tool call+output. On: words may appear in different parts of the same turn.
searchPopover.wholeWordDesc: Match full word boundaries (e.g. git will not match github or digit)
searchPopover.synAnd: All terms required (CLI flags like -c / --stat always search literally)
searchPopover.synNot: Exclude steps matching term or "phrase" (! or NOT — never hyphen -)

searchHistory.empty: No saved searches yet. Run a search or press Enter.

minimap.trackTitle: User prompts & markers — hover to preview, click to jump

composer.resizerTitle: Drag up or down to resize input height
composer.sendBtnWinTitle: Focus Antigravity.exe chat (Ctrl+I), verify empty -> paste, verify match, press Enter & return focus after ~1.8s; if draft exists (non-code) -> append at end without Enter
composer.placeholderWin: Write a message… (Ctrl+' — toggle panel, Enter — smart send/append into Antigravity, Shift+Enter — newline)
composer.sendBtnPosixTitle: Copy text to clipboard (Ctrl+' — toggle panel, Enter — copy, Shift+Enter — newline; auto-paste requires Windows)
composer.placeholderPosix: Write a message… (Ctrl+' — toggle panel, Enter — copy to clipboard, Shift+Enter — newline)
composer.clipboardModeDesc:
Auto-pasting into Antigravity.exe is supported on Windows only.
On this platform, Enter copies your draft to the clipboard.
composer.copiedDesc: Text copied to clipboard. Paste manually into Antigravity (Ctrl+V / Cmd+V).
composer.agFoundDesc:
Indicator color: GREEN (🟢 = found, ⚪ WHITE = not found, 🟡 YELLOW = sending).
Visible Antigravity.exe window found — pressing Enter checks the input via Ctrl+I → Ctrl+A → Ctrl+C:
• If empty: pastes, re-verifies, presses Enter, and returns focus back to browser.
• If a short draft exists: appends to the end without Enter.
• If focus landed inside code: aborts safely and copies to clipboard.
composer.agNotFoundDesc:
Indicator color: WHITE (⚪ = Antigravity.exe window not found or minimized without title, 🟢 GREEN = found).
Pressing Enter still copies text to clipboard.
composer.agSendingDesc: Indicator color: YELLOW (🟡 = checking Antigravity input emptiness, pasting, and verifying).
composer.agSentTitle: Verified, sent to Antigravity.exe & returning focus
composer.agSentDesc:
Indicator color: GREEN (🟢).
Antigravity input was empty, pasted text passed Ctrl+A/Ctrl+C verification, Enter was pressed, and browser focus restores after ~1.8s.
composer.agAppendedDesc:
Indicator color: GREEN (🟢).
Antigravity input already contained text, so your message was appended to the end without pressing Enter or stealing focus back.
composer.agPastedDesc:
Indicator color: GREEN (🟢).
Text pasted into Antigravity input (without pressing Enter) — review and send manually.
composer.traceToggleTitle: Show or hide last Antigravity paste log

cmdMap.filterOnlyTitle: When enabled, the feed shows only the event types and tools checked here
cmdMap.focusedOnlyTitle: When filtering, hide surrounding thinking, text, and sibling tools inside matched steps (keeping a local button to expand the full turn)
cmdMap.sectionTypes: Step types, statuses & subtypes (checked items show ★ markers on the right minimap)
cmdMap.sectionTools: Executed tools (breakdown by command and outcome)

fileModal.browserFmtDesc: HTML pages, Markdown, formatted JSON, code & text with line numbers
fileModal.browserRawDesc: Unformatted raw source text (text/plain) without HTML/Markdown rendering
fileModal.notepadDesc: Open code/text for editing in Notepad++ (does not execute scripts like .py)
fileModal.systemDesc: Open or execute with OS association (runs interpreter for scripts like .py; viewer for PDF/media)
fileModal.remember: Remember choice for all files (change or reset later in settings under 📑 Contents)

toc.title: 📑 Table of Contents
toc.formula: Cache hit formula: cache_read_tokens / (input_tokens + cache_read_tokens) × 100%. Click a square to highlight in table; Enter or click row to jump to step.
toc.barTipDesc:
{firstLine}

Cache: {hitPct}% ({cache} of {totIn}) · Click to highlight in table
toc.optAttachTools: Attach tool outputs to their callers
toc.optReadModeTitle: Display mode for read files and long tool blocks (read_file, edit_file, write_file, invoke_subagent, etc.)
toc.optDisableAutoLinksTitle: Disable automatic linkification of file paths/URLs (keep only explicit Markdown [text](url) links)
toc.optLinkifyShortTitle: Make short project filenames clickable (e.g. server.py, README.md)
toc.optFileTitle: How to open local files (.html, .md, .txt, code, etc.) when clicked
toc.optFileResetTitle: Clear remembered file action and ask every time
toc.optSearchFocusedTitle: Inside matched turns, show matching blocks & tools (always keeping their outputs visible) and hide sibling tools/blocks without all terms
toc.optSearchWholeTurnTitle: Allow space-separated search words to match in different blocks/outputs of the same turn

card.copyOneLineTitle: Copy as single && line (runs sequentially without newlines, won't auto-execute on paste)
card.copyPwshBlockTitle: Copy as single PowerShell & { ... } block (runs atomically after Enter)
card.cmdRunTitle: Execute command in active project folder via {shell}
card.cmdTermTitle: Run in separate interactive terminal window in project folder ({shell})
card.autoLinkWebDesc: Automatically created by the viewer from URL text.
card.autoLinkFileUriDesc: Automatically created by the viewer from file:/// URI.
card.autoLinkTranscriptDesc: Opens the target session directly inside this viewer.
card.autoLinkProjectDesc: Matched against active project files (toggle via «Project filenames»).
card.autoLinkCopyFileUriDesc: Auto-detected by viewer (copies as clean file:///).
card.toggleArgsTitle: Toggle parameters: 18-line scrollbox / full expanded view
card.toggleOutputTitle: Toggle output: 18-line scrollbox / full expanded view
card.toggleFormattedRawTitle: Switch between formatted view and raw text
card.toggleFormattedRawLinesTitle: Switch between formatted view and raw text with line numbers
card.taskPillPendingDesc: Result for this task has not appeared in the log yet (still running or cancelled).
card.thinkingTipDesc: Model internal Chain-of-Thought reasoning prior to action or response.
card.toolsTipDesc: List of tool invocations with name, arguments, and attached outputs.
card.unknownTypeDesc: Unknown/new step type (possibly added in a newer Antigravity version).
card.tsTooltipDesc:
Displayed in local time ({source}).
Stored in JSONL as ISO 8601 UTC.{localRaw}
card.tsTooltipLocalRaw: In step metadata: The current local time is: {val}
card.typeFinalDesc: Final AI response to the user (has content, no new tool_calls).
card.stepIndexDesc: Sequential step index in session log. Click copies active link for browser & AI.
card.modelDesc: Current active model tracked from Model Selection metadata in USER_INPUT.
card.contentDesc: Main message text, tool output, or compaction summary.
card.toolCallsMetaDesc: Array of tools invoked in this step.
card.mediaMetaDesc: Images or files attached to the user prompt.
card.unknownKeyDesc: Non-standard field in JSONL record (possibly a new Antigravity feature).
card.inTokDesc: Prompt tokens NOT served from cache (billed at full rate).
card.outTokDesc: Tokens generated by the model in this step.
card.rawStepDesc: Show/hide original JSONL record inline (also Shift+Right-Click).
card.toolRawDesc: Toggle this invocation's arguments as raw JSON.
card.outputStepIndexTitle: Output step_index #{step} (click to copy deep link)
card.outputStepIndexDesc: Sequential JSONL step number for this tool result. Click copies active link.
card.outputRawDesc: Toggle just this output as raw JSONL string.
card.unknownTagDesc: Non-standard tag inside content (possibly a new Antigravity feature).

args.CommandLine: Exact command string passed to the shell (PowerShell / cmd / sh).
args.WaitMsBeforeAsync: Milliseconds to wait synchronously (500–10000) before moving command to background (async task).
args.IsDaemon: If true, launches as a long-running background daemon/server without waiting for exit.
args.Path: Absolute path to the target file on disk.
args.TargetFile: Path to the file being edited.
args.DirectoryPath: Directory path to search or list.
args.StartLine: Start line number to read (1-based inclusive).
args.ByteOffset: Byte offset for continuing a large file read.
args.Target: Original text snippet being replaced (lines: deleted struck through, modified italic).
args.Replacement: New text snippet replacing Target (added bold, modified italic).
args.Content: Full content written to the file.
args.CodeContent: Full source code written to the file.
args.Overwrite: If true, overwrite an existing file completely.
args.Append: If true, append content to the end of an existing file.
args.query: Search query sent to web search or grep.
args.domain: Priority domain filter for web search.
args.TypeName: Subagent type name to launch (e.g. research, self).
args.Role: Short description of the subagent role (2–5 words).
args.Model: Subagent model selection (inherit, flash, flash_lite, pro).
args.Workspace: Subagent workspace isolation mode (inherit, branch, share).
args.Prompt: Task instructions passed to a subagent or scheduled timer.
args.Recipient: Recipient agent conversation ID for direct message.
args.Message: Text content sent to another agent.
args.Action: Action to perform on task or subagent (list, status, kill, send_input).
args.Input: Standard input string delivered to a running background task.
args.TimerCondition: Early-cancel trigger for timer (never, any, or sender ID).
args.ExactTiming: If true, fire cron at exact wall-clock boundary without jitter.
args.MaxIterations: Maximum trigger count before cron stops.
args.Name: Unique name for the new custom subagent type.
args.Description: Purpose description for the subagent type.
args.SystemPrompt: System prompt instructions for the subagent.
args.EnableMCPTools: Grant the subagent access to MCP tools.
args.EnableSubagentTools: Allow the subagent to define/invoke its own subagents.
args.EnableWriteTools: Allow the subagent to create/edit files and run commands.
args.questions: Structured clarification questions with selectable options for the user.

types.USER_INPUT: User prompt. May include <USER_REQUEST>, <ADDITIONAL_METADATA>, <USER_SETTINGS_CHANGE>, and media attachments.
types.PLANNER_RESPONSE: Model reasoning/response turn. Includes token metrics, optional thinking, tool_calls, and final content.
types.GENERIC: Tool execution result (run_command, read_file, edit_file, write_file, search_web, etc.).
types.SYSTEM_MESSAGE: System notification (e.g. background task completion). Wrapped in <SYSTEM_MESSAGE>.
types.CHECKPOINT: Context compaction checkpoint — prior conversation history compressed into a summary.
types.ERROR_MESSAGE: System or API network error (details in error field).

sources.USER_EXPLICIT: Triggered by an explicit message from the user.
sources.MODEL: Generated by the model or its tool execution.
sources.SYSTEM: Generated by the orchestrator/system (timers, API errors, checkpoints).

statuses.RUNNING: Task/command was still running (or moved to background) when recorded.

tools.run_command: Executes a shell command (PowerShell / cmd / bash / sh) in the project workspace.
tools.read_file: Reads file contents (text, image, PDF, audio, video) with optional line range.
tools.view_file: Reads file contents with line numbers.
tools.write_file: Creates a new file or overwrites an existing one.
tools.write_to_file: Creates a new file or overwrites an existing one.
tools.edit_file: Applies a targeted replacement to an existing file.
tools.replace_file_content: Applies a targeted replacement to an existing file.
tools.search_web: Performs a web search and returns a summary with URL citations.
tools.grep_search: Searches for regex/literal text matches in project files.
tools.find_by_name: Finds files and directories by name pattern.
tools.list_dir: Lists files and subdirectories inside a directory.
tools.invoke_subagent: Launches a background subagent with its own prompt and context.
tools.send_message: Sends a message to another agent or subagent.
tools.ask_question: Presents structured multiple-choice questions to the user.
